use_cases: Hero section banner with auto-scrolling imagery
Product showcase carousel for e-commerce sites
Background decorative element for landing pages
Visual branding element for creative agencies
ai_summary: An infinite image auto-slider component that displays a seamless horizontal scroll of images using CSS animations. The component duplicates the image array to create a continuous loop effect, making it ideal for hero sections, product showcases, or decorative visual elements on websites. Uses minimal styling with a dark theme and system fonts.
